#### Fully Remote // EdTech

- Line-managed and coached a team of 5 engineers, ranging from junior to senior level, setting context and supporting career growth while delivering the Foundation's flagship offerings [Code Editor](https://editor.raspberrypi.org) and [Projects Site](https://projects.raspberrypi.org/) as well as [Code Club World](https://codeclubworld.org/) and the initial development of [Experience AI](https://experience-ai.org).
- Responsible for the technical implementation and successful delivery of the integration of the Code Editor into the Projects Site for a more encompassing user learning experience.
- Maintained and developed new features utilising React and Ruby on Rails. Notably, I spearheaded the overhaul of the Projects Site homepage, implementing a modern and responsive design with improved navigation and discoverability.
- Introduced key user-led features into the Code Editor such as HTML/CSS functionality, furthering the types of projects users can create and our Code Editor for Education to enable teachers and students to utilise the editor's functionality in a safe and dedicated platform.
- Worked with designers on a pathways overhaul, breaking the work into an MVP and chunking it so multiple engineers could ship against a shared design system.
